limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、dsh-desktop-next/package.json、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/host.cordis.patch.yml、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/package.json、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/scripts/start.mjs、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/backend-controller.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/data-backup.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/data-directory.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/desktop-browser-access.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/desktop-contract.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/desktop-runtime.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/host-process.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/host/index.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/main.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/preload-app.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/profiles.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/runtime-tree.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/update-installer.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/updates.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/web-document.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/webserver.ts、dsh-plugin-desktop/package.json、package.json、upstream.json；active beta原生壳→正确home/profile→owned独立Host/ready/auth→受控app/WS载体；切换走应用重启，备份停Host/partial改名，访问偏好经IPC可关旧browser流。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。

findings.text: 为不想手管Node/Host的桌面用户组织原生启动、配置选择和恢复维护；根是社区客户端，核心Agent/Web归上游。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
active beta原生壳→正确home/profile→owned独立Host/ready/auth→受控app/WS载体；切换走应用重启，备份停Host/partial改名，访问偏好经IPC可关旧browser流。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。

根/三个子包版本与upstream声明、active beta开发入口/native main、home/profile ensure/select/load、backend attempt与Host spawn/ready/IPC/shutdown、窗口/preload/frame/header/app/WS/NextWebServer实际门、默认偏好、数据备份caller/copy/链接、局部profile repair锁、诊断/checkpoint、updater检查/下载入口/dispose及安装退出到Mac launch caller。未全审全部稳定/Next实现、Vendor Agent/工具、所有环境准备/权限/guest/LAN/远控市场插件、下载签名/安装脚本/平台恢复/数据迁移；未执行。
根private无统一version；stable2.0.18、active beta2.0.21-beta.1、next2.0.21-next；MIT，Node ^22.19或>=24、Yarn4.18.0，Electron声明44.7.0。上游三pin/runtime各异，root为client，子包/plugin机制不改这一对象类型；未验发布签名/真实包或全部vendor不变。
安装/构建和Electron+Host常驻、模型/插件网络与日志、备份空间和多阶段恢复人工分开；有默认更新检查，关窗不一定停，金额/净节时/TCO未测。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

已有本地Agent经验且想减启动维护者，只在独立OS账户/明确全新beta home和无敏感副本先试一任务，核实际持久home选择/profile/版本，保持browserAccess=false/loopback、remoteControl/market=false，不导入主数据/生产凭据或触发内置更新安装。分别核原生壳/Host ready、上游任务产物、备份外链和恢复、显式quit后的Host/外部工作，不把X、checkpoint或partial完成当全通过。身份/目录/权限、费用/备份或退出不明立即停并人工读回，要求主数据迁移、生产公网或内置更新的安全保证者先观察。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
源码支持桌面组织、实际owned生命周期/访问门及部分备份恢复；不证明开箱/所有插件、全目录可还原、真包更新/全任务停或优于Web。效果表见[Q05](#research-q05)。
可借鉴owned attempt cleanup保所有权、能力/owner frame与过期boot检查、普通browser旧流撤销、备份partial；全局锁/严格退出参数/签名需看真caller，不以helper/注释代替。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
实际原生Host独立的设置/恢复面、进程/目录profile与载体门卫、备份/更新维护组织；已有日志/checkpoint可复用，不是只加图标窗口。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
active beta不能继承stable旧owner锁/ABI上下文结论；备份的partial非所有写者一致/外链自包含。更新严格stop参数未在所核链启用，退出失败/timeout仍可能launcher handoff；局部门/ready不等全包签名或任务退出。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
已有原生诊断/恢复记录，不再造看板；先验证备份包含/外链/退化清单与恢复后正确home/profile的独立验收，现有功能/人工清单够用就否定独立产品。见[Q06](#research-q06)。
匹配beta包/runtime/平台与构建、实际home/profile和写权限、模型授权/预算、无外部writer及物理退出/读回必需；网络/市场/远控/更新按模式另审。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)成熟Electron/上游Host组织为主novelty9，未到清晰新方法差异18；[Q02](#research-q02)owned attempt、[Q03](#research-q03)cap/frame与旧流撤销、[Q04](#research-q04)partial/恢复构成实机制15超薄壳8，但更新/备份端到端正确性边界未到23；身份/所有权和提交/验收分层可迁移10超仅本项目经验5，强耦合Electron/upstream未到15；原生设置/恢复减少手工启动交接使简化8超仅安装便利4，平台/版本/数据维护仍重且无实测，未到11。

business.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)、[Q04](#research-q04)把启动/配置/恢复备份组织给桌面用户，workflow18超仅入口便利9，未到实证跨团队重组26；有实际Host身份/失败清理/备份提交/恢复展示使delivery15超纯UI8，但真包/所有恢复/退出验收未到23；[Q01](#research-q01)原生向导/设置可给不手管Node的用户新的使用方式，reach10超只后台便利5，不等实际新用户或分发规模15；固定运行时/同一owned Host、集中恢复与可用时文件clone改变资源/维护责任，economics4超无此组织0，但Electron常驻/平台与数据恢复负担未测，未到8，未知TCO不算实测节省。

recommendation.reason: 已有本地Agent经验且想减少启动维护的用户，只在独立OS账户、明确全新beta数据目录和无敏感项目副本中，核通道/profile与模型授权、保持私有默认并不触发内置更新安装，试一项本地任务。它比手工dsh web多了原生设置/恢复、owned Host与实际访问/备份生命周期，但ready/checkpoint、partial完成和严格stop helper都不能替代产物、可还原性与真更新/退出验收。home/权限/费用、备份或Host及外部工作状态不明就停并人工读回，不把主profile、生产凭据、公网或内置更新安全交给本轮未验证的路径。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q05](#research-q05)不手管Node的本地Agent用户和单任务启动/恢复验收具体，超泛桌面便利15；真实需求频次/收益未测，未到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)原生壳/owned Host、[Q03](#research-q03)载体门与[Q04](#research-q04)备份恢复比裸Web启动具体，超只换窗口6；平台/插件/全数据和更新仍需独立验收，未到稳定明显优势19。

evidence.rationale: 实际main/backend/Host、header/gate/旧流、backup/copy及失败更新handoff caller超文档/helper6，见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)；无安装/全平台/真实任务恢复与OS结果，未到19。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05)独立账户/新目录/无敏感数据、不开公网和真更新给可控小样，超0；[Q02](#research-q02)home优先与平台、[Q04](#research-q04)备份/退出/更新恢复负担重、TCO未知，未到10。

publication.summaries.text: 独立社区桌面客户端，将上游Host/Web与原生窗口、profile/数据目录、访问载体和恢复维护组织成桌面工作环境。

items.界面: 原生设置/向导/恢复与上游Web桌面载体
items.后台: owned Host进程、目录profile、访问/备份/更新与诊断生命周期
items.用户命令: 匹配通道的构建/开发启动入口，真实发行安装未验

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 用途 | 条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 原生壳/Host | 设置恢复可独立于Host，主任务由上游 | active beta代表链，不泛化三通道/Agent正确性 |
| home/profile | 选择/初始化迁移与切换 | 持久选择优先env，ensure会写，非全事务 |
| app/browser载体 | native能力/owner frame/旧browser流撤销 | 缺access/peer条件明确，非全插件或OS工具隔离 |
| 备份/恢复 | 停owned Host、partial改名、日志checkpoint | 非所有writer一致/外链自包含或加密保证 |
| 更新/退出 | 用户下载确认/owned dispose/Host IPC和信号等待 | timeout失败可handoff，真签名/完整安装与全任务退出未验 |

data.reports:
# DSH Desktop > 独立社区桌面客户端，将上游Host/Web与原生窗口、profile/数据目录、访问载体和恢复维护组织成桌面工作环境。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop) - **版本号**：根未声明统一版本；stable 2.0.18，active beta 2.0.21-beta.1，next 2.0.21-next（[固定提交 0e249397f8ae66dbb674ba85570f59bd0ecab14a](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/tree/0e249397f8ae66dbb674ba85570f59bd0ecab14a)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-29（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定根/三通道声明及当前active beta的native入口、目录/profile/owned Host、窗口/IPC/app/WS/浏览器门卫、整目录备份和更新退出重要支路已核；非三通道全实现/Vendor Agent/全插件市场远控/安全/签名安装/所有恢复矩阵审计，未运行。真实entry_type=client。仅建议独立账户/全新明确beta目录、无敏感副本、默认私有开关且不触发内置更新安装的小样；不交主profile/生产凭据或据此开公网。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：为不想手管Node/Host的桌面用户组织原生启动、配置选择和恢复维护；根是社区客户端，核心Agent/Web归上游。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：实际原生Host独立的设置/恢复面、进程/目录profile与载体门卫、备份/更新维护组织；已有日志/checkpoint可复用，不是只加图标窗口。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **思考**：active beta不能继承stable旧owner锁/ABI上下文结论；备份的partial非所有写者一致/外链自包含。更新严格stop参数未在所核链启用，退出失败/timeout仍可能launcher handoff；局部门/ready不等全包签名或任务退出。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **建议**：已有原生诊断/恢复记录，不再造看板；先验证备份包含/外链/退化清单与恢复后正确home/profile的独立验收，现有功能/人工清单够用就否定独立产品。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 采用建议：已有本地Agent经验且想减启动维护者，只在独立OS账户/明确全新beta home和无敏感副本先试一任务，核实际持久home选择/profile/版本，保持browserAccess=false/loopback、remoteControl/market=false，不导入主数据/生产凭据或触发内置更新安装。分别核原生壳/Host ready、上游任务产物、备份外链和恢复、显式quit后的Host/外部工作，不把X、checkpoint或partial完成当全通过。身份/目录/权限、费用/备份或退出不明立即停并人工读回，要求主数据迁移、生产公网或内置更新的安全保证者先观察。见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 核心贡献 实际原生Host独立的设置/恢复面、进程/目录profile与载体门卫、备份/更新维护组织；已有日志/checkpoint可复用，不是只加图标窗口。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 关键质疑 active beta不能继承stable旧owner锁/ABI上下文结论；备份的partial非所有写者一致/外链自包含。更新严格stop参数未在所核链启用，退出失败/timeout仍可能launcher handoff；局部门/ready不等全包签名或任务退出。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 已有原生诊断/恢复记录，不再造看板；先验证备份包含/外链/退化清单与恢复后正确home/profile的独立验收，现有功能/人工清单够用就否定独立产品。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 未来隔离同条件对照Web，测实际home优先/坏profile/runtime、Host/renderer故障、旧流/门卫、备份外链/并发writer/还原、退出超时与假installer handoff，记录误判/正确恢复、资源/工时与任务费用；不在主数据和真安装上直接试。 ## 场景与替代办法 为不想手管Node/Host的桌面用户组织原生启动、配置选择和恢复维护；根是社区客户端，核心Agent/Web归上游。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 对照同模型/插件条件的上游dsh web与手工启动/备份清单，不把upstream/Vendor、插件和模型本身算桌面原创。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 依赖与流程 匹配beta包/runtime/平台与构建、实际home/profile和写权限、模型授权/预算、无外部writer及物理退出/读回必需；网络/市场/远控/更新按模式另审。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 新账户/明确全新home核channel/profile→私有默认向导/正常启动→一个无敏感任务独立验产物→停owned Host做备份/外链还原核验→显式quit核物理退出；主数据/更新另审。执行者表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：固定根对象的active beta真实启动/访问/备份及退出链能支持什么桌面采用，哪里不能沿旧稳定插件或状态作保证？ ### Q01 · 当前桌面对象、通道和真实增量是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 根deepseek-harness-desktop是private工作区、MIT、Node ^22.19或>=24、Yarn 4.18.0，未声明统一version；独立社区桌面客户端而非官方背书产品/根DSH插件。三个子包各有版本：stable dsh-plugin-desktop 2.0.18，active beta dsh-plugin-desktop-beta 2.0.21-beta.1，next dsh-desktop-next 2.0.21-next；不能把子包/安装包/上游runtime和根版本混成一个发布号。package.json约339KiB，准备器作者摘录因256KiB上限为空，已单独读固定原文件，不是源码不可得。 upstream.json当前activeChannel=beta：stable pin1f81c047…/0.2.1-rc.3，beta pinf3803c96…/0.2.2-alpha.2，next pin504a01a9…/0.2.1-rc.4。它们是本项目声明的构建来源/运行包口径，不是本轮已验证全部vendor无修改、真实发行已签名可运行，也不把beta f380当正式Host22ddee研究同版。核心模型/Agent/会话/Web由所选上游和插件提供，不把fork历史/代码量算桌面原创。 面向不想手管Node/Host启动、窗口/托盘、配置和恢复的桌面用户，相对直接dsh web，实际增量是原生壳、独立Host进程生命周期、本地profile/数据目录、访问载体、备份与更新/恢复组织。合格结果要是正确通道/目录/profile启动、能继续工作且可核退出/恢复，不是窗口出现或Agent任务完成。源码开发入口start.mjs先检查lib/main/host/client/preloads及Market构建，再spawn Electron；本轮没有构建/启动或安装发布包，不能作开箱体验验收。 本轮代表选择当前active beta，不沿用旧正式092e2ecef750d10db43cedbab8e81fd48c8de38e对稳定插件的profile-context/data-operation-lock/update-lifecycle等判断。旧四题、全部findings/自代码依赖及9路径已完整只读；当前beta是Host-independent native shell+独立Host子进程，不能将stable机制自动算到beta或next。仅核beta启动/profile、原生载体/门卫、备份和更新退出重要支路；未全审所有通道、Vendor Agent/协议、插件/市场/远控、平台签名/安装、权限/guest/全部UI或数据迁移，未执行目标。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[package.json:1-10](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/blob/0e249397f8ae66dbb674ba85570f59bd0ecab14a/package.json#L1-L10) 根private/许可/引擎/包管理口径，无统一版本。

[`dsh-plugin-desktop/README.md`](dsh-plugin-desktop/README.md) |\n\n## 主要功能\n\n<table>\n  <tr>\n    <td width=\"50%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <h3>Desktop</h3>\n      <p>把上游 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Web UI 带到原生桌面。应用自动启动和管理本地 Harness 服务，集成系统托盘与桌面窗口，无需安装 Node.js 或执行命令。</p>\n    </td>\n    <td width=\"50%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <h3><a href=\"https://www.agents-anywhere.com\">手机远程控制</a> <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/%E5%B7%B2%E5%86%85%E7%BD%AE-2EA44F?style=flat-square\" alt=\"已内置\"></h3>\n      <p>通过 iOS 和 Android 远程连接 Desktop，在手机上发起任务、查看 Agent 进度，并在需要时继续跟进。已在2.0.9及以上版本中内置</p>\n    </td>\n  </tr>\n  <tr>\n    <td width=\"50%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <h3><a href=\"dsh-community-market/README.zh.md\">插件市场</a> <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/%E5%B7%B2%E5%86%85%E7%BD%AE-2EA44F?style=flat-square\" alt=\"已内置\"></h3>\n      <p>DSH Community Market 已完成并内置，提供插件发现、详情、安装与管理。市场以开放方式连接各种插件数据源：任何人都可以提供、接入和使用符合公开 Schema 的来源，已有 API 也可以通过受审 adapter 加入合作数据源。</p>\n    </td>\n    <td width=\"50%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <h3>共建插件生态</h3>\n      <p>DSH 的插件生态由社区共同建设。上游插件、DSH Desktop 插件和其他社区插件遵循统一的约定，可以通过相同的组合机制共同工作；欢迎加入共建，详见 <a href=\"docs/plugin-ecosystem.md\">DSH 插件生态倡议书</a>。</p>\n    </td>\n  </tr>\n</table>\n\n### 首次设置、浏览器与局域网访问\n\n每个尚未初始化的 profile 正常首次启动时，会先显示由 Desktop 自己提供的原生 Setup Wizard。它可以设置窗口模式与系统材质、插件市场、通知、是否用系统默认浏览器自动打开，以及 Web 访问范围；也可以直接跳过。向导完成或跳过以前，Host 和主 DSH 窗口都不会启动。完成或跳过状态按 profile 分别记录；显式恢复启动仍优先进入恢复助手。\n\nWeb 服务默认仅监听本机回环地址。开启“用浏览器打开”后，Desktop 会在 Web 服务实际就绪时交给系统默认浏览器打开；这个选项不会改变网络暴露范围。“桌面设置”会在选项下显示实际的本机 URL。局域网访问是一个独立的可选设置，开启后还会显示当前可用的局域网 URL。\n\n> **危险：** 向局域网开放不提供鉴权；所有与你处于同一局域网的人都能直接打开 DSH 并操作你的电脑。请只在完全信任的网络中谨慎开启。\n\n自动更新的固定版本检查请求会在 `X-DSH-Desktop-Version` header 中携带当前安装版本，在 `X-DSH-Desktop-Channel` 中携带 `stable` 或 `beta`，并在 `X-DSH-Desktop-Installation-Id` header 中携带一个由本机生成并持久保存的随机 UUID；它不是从硬件信息推导出的标识。安装包下载会携带通道和 `X-DSH-Desktop-Target-Version`，但下载请求及其重定向不会携带安装标识或当前版本。\n\n## 插件生态\n\n插件是给 DSH 添加能力的扩展包——模型、工具、界面、工作流都可以做成插件，像搭积木一样自由组合。\n\nDSH Desktop 没有修改上游源码，也不是一个固定写死的外壳。固定版本的上游 DeepSeek Harness 原样运行；桌面壳本身——窗口、托盘、终端、更新、工作配置——作为 DSH 插件接入，并通过 DeepSeek Harness 提供的插件机制与上游能力组合进同一个运行时。从核心 agent 到桌面外壳，整个产品遵守同一条\"一切皆插件\"的规则：与所固定上游版本兼容的插件可以使用，桌面能力也按插件的方式组合、替换和演进。\n\n我们希望插件生态像手机应用一样：每个插件按同一套规则开发，装在一起也能一起工作、互不干扰。\n\n### 给开发者\n\n与许多其他项目不同，这个项目本身就是一个 DSH [插件](docs/plugin-development.md)：桌面壳与第三方插件使用相同的插件组合机制。Desktop 的插件能力已经可以使用。我们提供了 Desktop 服务，让插件开发者能够把插件与桌面能力集成起来：例如查看和切换工作配置，或在当前配置中安装、更新和移除插件。完整用法见[桌面插件接口说明](dsh-plugin-desktop/docs/plugin-services.zh.md)。为什么选择这样的边界、哪些能力不会暴露给第三方插件，见[为什么做 DSH Desktop](docs/why-desktop.md)和[插件开发指南](docs/plugin-development.md)。\n\n## 与 DeepSeek Harness 的关系\n\nDSH Desktop 是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 和 Cordis 插件思想构建的独立社区项目，旨在提供开放、可组合的 DSH 桌面体验。\n\n本仓库由社区独立维护，目前不存在深度求索员工或 DeepSeek Harness 上游官方团队成员参与本项目开发、维护或治理的情形。GitHub Contributors 页面中可能出现的上游贡献者，来自本仓库 fork 时继承及后续同步的上游提交历史；该署名仅反映提交来源，不代表相关人员参与本仓库，也不构成任何隶属、合作、授权或背书关系。\n\n上游项目提供核心的智能体能力、插件系统和 Web UI；DSH Desktop 主要负责：\n\n- 桌面应用封装\n- 本地服务的启动、停止与恢复\n- 桌面窗口和系统托盘集成\n- macOS、Windows 安装包构建与发布\n- 更适合桌面使用的界面体验\n\n如果你希望通过命令行运行 DeepSeek Harness，或者参与其核心功能开发，请优先查看上游仓库。\n\n## 特别感谢\n\n特别感谢 [DeepSeek Harness 原始仓库](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 和 DeepSeek AI 团队。DSH Desktop       "path": "dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/scripts/start.mjs",
      "content": "/** Explicit GUI entry; build/check never calls this script. */\nimport { spawn } from 'node:child_process'\nimport { existsSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { createRequire } from 'node:module'\nimport { dirname, join } from 'node:path'\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'\nconst root = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url))\nconst require = createRequire(join(root, 'package.json'))\nfor (const file of ['lib/main.js', 'lib/host.js', 'lib/client.js', 'lib/preload-app.cjs', 'lib/preload-shell.cjs']) {\n  if (!existsSync(join(root, file))) throw new Error('Run corepack yarn dev:next from the repository root to build Next first.')\n}\nconst market = dirname(require.resolve('dsh-community-market/package.json'))\nif (!existsSync(join(market, 'lib/client.js'))) throw new Error('Build the Community Market first: corepack yarn workspace dsh-community-market build')\nconst electron = require('electron')\nconst env = { ...process.env }\ndelete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE\nconst child = spawn(electron, [root], { cwd: root, env, stdio: 'inherit' })\nchild.once('error', error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1 })\nchild.once('exit', code => { process.exitCode = code ?? 1 })\n"

      "path": "dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/backend-controller.ts",
      "content": "/** Owns one backend startup and its quiescent teardown independently of windows. */\n\nimport { desktopErrorState } from './startup-error.ts'\n\n/** Backend availability presented by the desktop window. */\nexport type DesktopBackendState =\n  | { readonly phase: 'starting' }\n  | { readonly phase: 'ready' }\n  /** `message` is the rendered text; `failure` is the original error so a crash report keeps its stack, properties, and cause. */\n  | { readonly phase: 'error'; readonly message: string; readonly failure: unknown }\n\n/** The error state for one failure: rendered message plus the failure itself. */\nfunction errorState(failure: unknown): DesktopBackendState {\n  return { ...desktopErrorState(failure), failure }\n}\n\n/** Child lifecycle owned by the desktop backend controller. */\nexport interface DesktopBackendHost {\n  /** @returns Readiness after the child accepts application requests. */\n  start(): Promise<unknown>\n  /** @returns Completion of child exit. */\n  stop(): Promise<void>\n}\n\ninterface Attempt<Host> {\n  cancelled: boolean\n  failure?: Error\n  host?: Host\n  cleanup?: Promise<void>\n}\n\n/** Serializes retries and prevents children from outliving a closed window. */\nexport class DesktopBackendController<Host extends DesktopBackendHost> {\n  private current: DesktopBackendState = { phase: 'starting' }\n  private attempt: Attempt<Host> | undefined\n  private pending: Promise<void> | undefined\n  private stopping: Promise<void> | undefined\n  private closed = false\n\n  /**\n   * @param createHost - Allocate a child and route its fatal failures to the supplied callback.\n   * @param publish - Receive availability changes until the controller closes.\n   */\n  constructor(\n    private readonly createHost: (onFailure: (error: Error) => void) => Host,\n    private readonly publish: (state: DesktopBackendState) => void,\n  ) {}\n\n  /** Current availability, including the last startup or child failure. */\n  get state(): DesktopBackendState { return this.current }\n\n  /** Child available to application requests; absent during startup and teardown. */\n  get host(): Host | undefined { return !this.closed && !this.attempt?.cancelled && this.current.phase === 'ready' ? this.attempt?.host : undefined }\n\n  /**\n   * Prepare the profile and start one child; concurrent callers share the attempt.\n   * @param prepare - Profile preparation that must finish before spawning.\n   * @returns Completion of startup, rejecting on preparation, startup, or cleanup failure.\n   */\n  start(prepare: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.closed) return Promise.reject(new Error('desktop backend is closed'))\n    if (this.stopping !== undefined) return Promise.reject(new Error('desktop backend is stopping'))\n    if (this.pending !== undefined) return this.pending\n    if (this.current.phase === 'ready') return Promise.resolve()\n    const previous = this.attempt\n    const attempt: Attempt<Host> = { cancelled: false,\n      ...(previous?.host === undefined ? {} : { host: previous.host }),\n      ...(previous?.cleanup === undefined ? {} : { cleanup: previous.cleanup }) }\n    this.attempt = attempt\n    this.update({ phase: 'starting' })\n    const pending = Promise.resolve().then(async () => {\n      let replacing = previous !== undefined\n      try {\n        if (replacing) await this.cleanup(attempt)\n        delete attempt.cleanup\n        delete attempt.host\n        replacing = false\n        if (attempt.cancelled) return\n        await prepare()\n        // stop() can cancel this attempt while preparation is pending.\n        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-condition\n        if (attempt.cancelled) return\n        const host = this.createHost((error) => { this.failed(attempt, error) })\n        attempt.host = host\n        await host.start()\n        if (attempt.failure !== undefined) throw attempt.failure\n        // stop() can cancel this attempt while the child starts.\n        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-condition\n        if (!attempt.cancelled) this.update({ phase: 'ready' })\n      } catch (error) {\n        // Inherited cleanup belongs to the previous attempt; its rejection\n        // must also release this attempt's cache while retaining the same Host.\n        if (replacing) delete attempt.cleanup\n        const cancelled = attempt.cancelled\n        attempt.cancelled = true\n        let failure = error\n        try { if (!replacing) await this.cleanup(attempt) } catch (cleanupError) {\n          if (cleanupError !== error) failure = new AggregateError([error, cleanupError], 'desktop backend startup and cleanup failed')\n        }\n        if (!cancelled) this.update(errorState(failure))\n        throw failure\n      }\n    }).finally(() => { if (this.pending === pending) this.pending = undefined })\n    this.pending = pending\n    return pending\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Stop pending preparation and the child before allowing another start.\n   * @returns Completion of pending work and child exit; rejects if cleanup fails.\n   */\n  stop(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.stopping !== undefined) return this.stopping\n    const attempt = this.attempt\n    if (attempt !== undefined) attempt.cancelled = true\n    if (!this.closed) this.update({ phase: 'starting' })\n    const pending = this.pending\n    const stopping = Promise.allSettled([\n      attempt === undefined ? Promise.resolve() : this.cleanup(attempt),\n      pending,\n    ]).then((results) => {\n      const cleanup = results[0]\n      if (cleanup.status === 'rejected') throw cleanup.reason\n      if (this.attempt === attempt) this.attempt = undefined\n    }).finally(() => { if (this.stopping === stopping) this.stopping = undefined })\n    this.stopping = stopping\n    return stopping\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Permanently prevent startup and suppress further availability notifications.\n   * @returns Completion of pending work and child exit; rejects if cleanup fails.\n   */\n  close(): Promise<void> {\n    this.closed = true\n    return this.stop()\n  }\n\n  private cleanup(attempt: Attempt<Host>): Promise<void> {\n    if (attempt.cleanup === undefined) {\n      const cleanup = Promise.resolve().then(async () => { await attempt.host?.stop() }).catch((error: unknown) => {\n        // A failed termination retains Host ownership but permits another stop\n        // attempt. Never start a replacement until that stop actually succeeds.\n        if (attempt.cleanup === cleanup) delete attempt.cleanup\n        throw error\n      })\n      attempt.cleanup = cleanup\n    }\n    return attempt.cleanup\n  }\n\n  private failed(attempt: Attempt<Host>, error: Error): void {\n    if (this.attempt !== attempt || attempt.cancelled) return\n    attempt.failure = error\n    if (this.current.phase !== 'ready') return\n    attempt.cancelled = true\n    const cleanup = this.cleanup(attempt)\n    this.update(errorState(error))\n    void cleanup.catch((cleanupError: unknown) => {\n      if (this.attempt === attempt) this.update(errorState(new AggregateError([error, cleanupError], 'Desktop backend failed and could not stop')))\n    })\n  }\n\n  private update(state: DesktopBackendState): void {\n    if (this.closed) return\n    this.current = state\n    try { this.publish(state) } catch (error) {\n      console.error('desktop backend state listener failed', error)\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/data-backup.ts",
      "content": "/** Copy a stopped Next data directory into a new folder that can later be selected as a data directory. */\nimport { constants } from 'node:fs'\nimport { copyFile, lstat, mkdir, readdir, readlink, rename, rm, stat, symlink } from 'node:fs/promises'\nimport { basename, dirname, isAbsolute, join, relative, resolve, sep } from 'node:path'\n\n/** Chromium keeps live, machine-bound state there and rebuilds it; a former choice file would redirect the copy. */\nconst SKIPPED = new Set(['electron-user-data', 'desktop-next-location.json'])\n/** Clone where the file system can (APFS, ReFS, btrfs); never replace an existing file. */\nconst COPY_MODE = constants.COPYFILE_EXCL | constants.COPYFILE_FICLONE\n\nfunction contains(parent: string, child: string): boolean {\n  const path = relative(parent, child)\n  return path === '' || (path !== '..' && !path.startsWith(`..${sep}`) && !isAbsolute(path))\n}\n\nexport function backupDirectoryName(home: string, now = new Date()): string {\n  const two = (value: number): string => String(value).padStart(2, '0')\n  const stamp = `${now.getFullYear()}${two(now.getMonth() + 1)}${two(now.getDate())}-${two(now.getHours())}${two(now.getMinutes())}${two(now.getSeconds())}`\n  return `${basename(home).replace(/^\\.+/u, '') || 'dsh'}-backup-${stamp}`\n}\n\nexport function assertBackupLocation(home: string, destination: string): void {\n  if (contains(resolve(home), resolve(destination))) throw new Error('Choose a backup location outside the current data directory')\n}\n\n/**\n * Copy files, directories and links without following links. Links into the data directory are\n * retargeted into the copy, so the backup never depends on the original; on Windows, directory\n * links become junctions, which need no privilege. The copy is written beside the destination\n * under a `.partial` name and renamed only when complete, so an interrupted backup is never\n * mistaken for a whole one; a failed copy removes it.\n */\nexport async function copyDataDirectory(source: string, destination: string): Promise<void> {\n  const from = resolve(source), to = resolve(destination)\n  assertBackupLocation(from, to)\n  if (await lstat(to).then(() => true, () => false)) throw new Error(`Backup destination already exists: ${to}`)\n  const partial = `${to}.partial`\n  await mkdir(partial, { mode: 0o700 })\n  try {\n    await copyEntries(from, partial, to, from, to)\n    await rename(partial, to)\n  } catch (error) {\n    await rm(partial, { recursive: true, force: true })\n    throw error\n  }\n}\n\n/** `written` is where an entry is copied now; `final` is where it lives after the rename. */\nasync function copyEntries(directory: string, written: string, final: string, from: string, to: string): Promise<void> {\n  for (const name of await readdir(directory)) {\n    if (directory === from && SKIPPED.has(name)) continue\n    const path = join(directory, name), copy = join(written, name)\n    const info = await lstat(path)\n    if (info.isSymbolicLink()) await copyLink(path, copy, join(final, name), from, to)\n    else if (info.isDirectory()) {\n      await mkdir(copy, { mode: (info.mode & 0o777) | 0o700 })\n      await copyEntries(path, copy, join(final, name), from, to)\n    } else if (info.isFile()) await copyFile(path, copy, COPY_MODE)\n    // Sockets, pipes and devices belong to running processes, not to the data.\n  }\n}\n\nasync function copyLink(path: string, copy: string, final: string, from: string, to: string): Promise<void> {\n  const link = await readlink(path)\n  const resolved = resolve(dirname(path), link)\n  const target = !contains(from, resolved) ? resolved : isAbsolute(link) ? join(to, relative(from, resolved)) : link\n  if (process.platform !== 'win32') { await symlink(target, copy); return }\n  const directory = await stat(path).then(info => info.isDirectory(), () => undefined)\n  if (directory === true) { await symlink(resolve(dirname(final), target), copy, 'junction'); return }\n  try { await symlink(target, copy, 'file') } catch {\n    // File links need Developer Mode on Windows, so keep the content; a dangling link has none.\n    if (directory === false) await copyFile(path, copy, COPY_MODE)\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/data-directory.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Resolve the Next data directory: a directory chosen in the app wins, `DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME`\n * applies only without one, and `~/.dsh` is the default. The choice and the record of the last\n * launch live in one fixed directory, outside every data directory and independent of the\n * environment, so neither moves when the variable is added, changed or lost.\n */\nimport { lstatSync, readdirSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { homedir } from 'node:os'\nimport { isAbsolute, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path'\nimport { atomicJson, privateDirectory, readPrivateFile } from './private-files.ts'\n\nexport const DATA_DIRECTORY_VARIABLE = 'DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME'\nconst LOCATION_FILE = 'desktop-next-location.json'\nconst LAST_HOME_FILE = 'desktop-next-last-home.json'\n\nexport type DataDirectorySource = 'desktop' | 'environment' | 'default'\n\nexport interface DataDirectoryLocation {\n  home: string\n  source: DataDirectorySource\n  /** The directory used without an in-app choice: the variable when set, otherwise the default. */\n  fallback: string\n  error?: string\n}\n\nexport function defaultDataDirectory(userHome = homedir()): string { return join(userHome, '.dsh-beta') }\n\nexport function dataDirectoryLocationRoot(packaged: boolean, appData: () => string, packageRoot: string): string {\n  return packaged ? join(appData(), 'DSH Desktop Beta', 'home') : join(packageRoot, '.desktop-next', 'home')\n}\n\nexport function dataDirectoryLocationFile(locationRoot: string): string { return join(locationRoot, LOCATION_FILE) }\n\nfunction readHome(path: string): string | undefined {\n  const value = JSON.parse(readPrivateFile(path) ?? 'null') as unknown\n  if (value === null) return undefined\n  if (typeof value !== 'object' || !('home' in value) || typeof value.home !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(value.home)) throw new Error('Invalid Next data directory')\n  return resolve(value.home)\n}\n\nfunction fallbackDirectory(environmentHome: string | undefined, userHome?: string): string {\n  return environmentHome ? resolve(environmentHome) : defaultDataDirectory(userHome)\n}\n\nexport function readDataDirectory(locationRoot: string, environmentHome?: string, userHome?: string): DataDirectoryLocation {\n  const fallback = fallbackDirectory(environmentHome, userHome)\n  const source = environmentHome ? 'environment' : 'default'\n  try {\n    const home = readHome(dataDirectoryLocationFile(locationRoot))\n    if (home === undefined) return { home: fallback, source, fallback }\n    privateDirectory(home)\n    return { home, source: 'desktop', fallback }\n  } catch (error) { return { home: fallback, source, fallback, error: String(error) } }\n}\n\n/**\n * The data directory of the last launch. Until one is recorded, the former rule answers: the\n * variable used to move the choice into its own directory, so an upgrade cannot switch silently.\n */\nfunction previousDataDirectory(locationRoot: string, environmentHome?: string, userHome?: string): { home: string; recorded: boolean } {\n  try {\n    const recorded = readHome(join(locationRoot, LAST_HOME_FILE))\n    if (recorded !== undefined) return { home: recorded, recorded: true }\n  } catch { /* An unreadable record falls back to the former rule. */ }\n  const fallback = fallbackDirectory(environmentHome, userHome)\n  let home = fallback\n  try { home = readHome(dataDirectoryLocationFile(environmentHome ? fallback : locationRoot)) ?? fallback } catch { /* The fallback stands. */ }\n  return { home, recorded: false }\n}\n\n/**\n * The last launch's directory when this launch would leave it for another one: it still holds\n * Next data, or it was recorded and cannot be reached now, such as on a disconnected drive.\n */\nexport function dataDirectoryChange(locationRoot: string, home: string, environmentHome?: string, userHome?: string): { previous: string; reachable: boolean } | undefined {\n  const previous = previousDataDirectory(locationRoot, environmentHome, userHome)\n  if (sameDirectory(previous.home, home)) return undefined\n  let reachable = false\n  try { reachable = lstatSync(previous.home, { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isDirectory() === true } catch { /* Unreachable. */ }\n  if (reachable ? !holdsNextData(previous.home) : !previous.recorded) return undefined\n  return { previous: previous.home, reachable }\n}\n\nexport function rememberDataDirectory(locationRoot: string, home: string): void {\n  const path = join(locationRoot, LAST_HOME_FILE)\n  try { if (readHome(path) === resolve(home)) return } catch { /* Replace an unreadable record. */ }\n  atomicJson(path, { home: resolve(home) })\n}\n\n/** Compare as the file system resolves both paths, ignoring case on Windows. */\nexport function sameDirectory(left: string, right: string): boolean {\n  const canonical = (path: string): string => { try { return realpathSync.native(path) } catch { return resolve(path) } }\n  const [a, b] = [canonical(left), canonical(right)]\n  return process.platform === 'win32' ? a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase() : a === b\n}\n\n/** A directory that a Next launch has already set up. */\nfunction holdsNextData(home: string): boolean {\n  const isFile = (path: string): boolean => lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isFile() === true\n  try { return isFile(join(home, 'desktop-next.json')) || isFile(join(home, 'profiles', 'desktop', 'package.json')) } catch { return false }\n}\n\n/** The fallback directory may already hold data shared with Stable or the CLI. */\nexport function validateDataDirectory(target: string, current: string, fallback: string): string {\n  if (!isAbsolute(target) || target.includes('\\0')) throw new Error('Data directory must be an absolute path')\n  const destination = resolve(target)\n  const nested = relative(current, destination)\n  if (nested && !nested.startsWith('..') && !isAbsolute(nested)) throw new Error('Choose a directory outside the current data directory')\n  privateDirectory(destination)\n  const entries = readdirSync(destination)\n  if (destination !== fallback && destination !== current && entries.length > 0 && !holdsNextData(destination)) {\n    throw new Error('Choose an empty directory or an existing Next data directory')\n  }\n  return destination\n}\n"

      "content": "/** Generation-scoped capability separating Electron from ordinary browsers. */\n\nimport { randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'\nimport type { IncomingHttpHeaders } from 'node:http'\nimport { NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER } from './desktop-contract.ts'\n\n/** Header attached only by the Electron renderer's native network session. */\nexport const DESKTOP_RENDERER_ACCESS_HEADER = NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER\n\nlet nextAccess: DesktopBrowserAccess | undefined\n/** Called before boot; credentials are removed from the inherited environment. */\nexport function configureNextBrowserAccess(token: string | undefined, enabled: boolean): void {\n  nextAccess = token === undefined ? undefined : createDesktopBrowserAccess(enabled, token)\n}\nexport function nextBrowserAccess(): DesktopBrowserAccess | undefined { return nextAccess }\n\nconst ACCESS_TOKEN_BYTES = 32\nconst ACCESS_TOKEN_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/u\nconst DESKTOP_MARKER_PREFIX = 'dsh-desktop-'\n\n/** Header value retained only in main-process and Host-generation memory. */\nexport interface DesktopRendererAccessHeader {\n  readonly name: typeof DESKTOP_RENDERER_ACCESS_HEADER\n  readonly value: string\n}\n\n/** Browser-access policy fixed for one Desktop Host generation. */\nexport interface DesktopBrowserAccess {\n  /** Whether marker-free ordinary-browser traffic may currently reach the Web carrier. */\n  readonly ordinaryBrowserEnabled: boolean\n  /** Ephemeral capability proving that a request came from the Electron renderer. */\n  readonly rendererHeader: DesktopRendererAccessHeader\n  /** Change ordinary-browser access without rebuilding the Host generation. */\n  setOrdinaryBrowserEnabled(enabled: boolean): void\n}\n\n/** Request classes understood by the Desktop-owned WebServer gate. */\nexport type DesktopBrowserAccessDecision = 'renderer' | 'browser' | 'denied'\n\n/** Create one unpredictable renderer capability for a Desktop Host generation. */\nexport function createDesktopBrowserAccess(\n  ordinaryBrowserEnabled: boolean,\n  token: string = randomBytes(ACCESS_TOKEN_BYTES).toString('base64url'),\n): DesktopBrowserAccess {\n  if (typeof ordinaryBrowserEnabled !== 'boolean') {\n    throw new TypeError('dsh-plugin-desktop-beta: ordinary browser access must be a boolean')\n  }\n  if (!ACCESS_TOKEN_PATTERN.test(token)) {\n    throw new TypeError('dsh-plugin-desktop-beta: renderer access token must be 32 base64url bytes')\n  }\n  let enabled = ordinaryBrowserEnabled\n  return Object.freeze({\n    get ordinaryBrowserEnabled() { return enabled },\n    rendererHeader: Object.freeze({\n      name: DESKTOP_RENDERER_ACCESS_HEADER,\n      value: token,\n    }),\n    setOrdinaryBrowserEnabled(next: boolean) {\n      if (typeof next !== 'boolean') {\n        throw new TypeError('dsh-plugin-desktop-beta: ordinary browser access must be a boolean')\n      }\n      enabled = next\n    },\n  })\n}\n\nfunction exactHeaderValue(headers: IncomingHttpHeaders): string | undefined {\n  const value = headers[DESKTOP_RENDERER_ACCESS_HEADER]\n  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined\n}\n\nfunction sameToken(actual: string | undefined, expected: string): boolean {\n  if (actual === undefined || !ACCESS_TOKEN_PATTERN.test(actual) || actual.length !== expected.length) return false\n  return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(actual), Buffer.from(expected))\n}\n\n/** Whether an uncredentialed URL is attempting to activate Desktop-only client effects. */\nexport function desktopBrowserUrlHasRendererMarkers(rawUrl: string | undefined): boolean {\n  let url: URL\n  try {\n    url = new URL(rawUrl ?? '/', 'http://dsh.invalid')\n  } catch {\n    return true\n  }\n  return [...url.searchParams.keys()].some(key => key.startsWith(DESKTOP_MARKER_PREFIX))\n}\n\n/** Classify one HTTP or upgrade request without exposing the renderer token. */\nexport function decideDesktopBrowserAccess(\n  access: DesktopBrowserAccess,\n  request: { readonly headers: IncomingHttpHeaders; readonly url?: string | undefined },\n): DesktopBrowserAccessDecision {\n  if (sameToken(exactHeaderValue(request.headers), access.rendererHeader.value)) return 'renderer'\n  if (!access.ordinaryBrowserEnabled || desktopBrowserUrlHasRendererMarkers(request.url)) return 'denied'\n  return 'browser'\n}\n\ndeclare module '@deepseek-ai/cordis' {\n  interface Context {\n    /** Launcher-owned request gate present only in a Desktop Host generation. */\n    desktopBrowserAccess: DesktopBrowserAccess\n  }\n}\n"

live state belongs to pluginManager. */\n  onboardingComputerUse?: boolean\n  home: string\n  /** How `home` was chosen: in the app (wins), by `DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME`, or by default. */\n  dataDirectory?: { source: 'desktop' | 'environment' | 'default';       "content": "/** Headless owner of the Host, desktop preferences, Profiles and recovery. */\nimport { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { cleanupDisposableTree } from '../../dsh-plugin-desktop/src/disposable-tree.ts'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\nimport { DesktopBackendController } from './backend-controller.ts'\nimport { DesktopHostExitError, DesktopHostFatalError, DesktopHostProcess, type DesktopPlatformLoginRequest } from './host-process.ts'\nimport { DesktopPreferenceStore, parsePreferences } from './desktop-preferences.ts'\nimport { DEFAULT_FEATURES, NextProfiles } from './profiles.ts'\nimport { DEFAULT_PREFERENCES, DEFAULT_PROFILE, SAFE_MODE_PREFERENCES, type DesktopBrowserLinks, type DesktopPreferences, type DesktopState, type DesktopNotification } from './desktop-contract.ts'\nimport { DesktopDiagnostics } from './diagnostics.ts'\nimport type { DesktopHostExit } from './exit-code.ts'\nimport { DesktopMemoryMonitor, type DesktopMemoryProbe } from './memory-monitor.ts'\nimport { NextRecovery } from './recovery.ts'\nimport { maskSecrets } from './mask-secrets.ts'\nimport { privateDirectory } from './private-files.ts'\nimport { authenticateWebHost } from './web-document.ts'\nimport { DesktopLanHttpsRuntime } from './lan-https-runtime.ts'\nimport type { DesktopLanHttpsCertificate } from './lan-https-certificate.ts'\nimport type { DesktopPermission, DesktopPermissionAction, DesktopPermissionSnapshot } from './permissions.ts'\nimport { SYSTEM_PROXY_ENV, type DesktopSystemProxyProbe } from './system-proxy.ts'\nimport type { DesktopFailureStage } from '../../dsh-plugin-desktop/src/recovery-copy.ts'\n\ninterface RuntimeOptions {\n  home: string\n  /** Disposable desktop settings; recovery continues to address the original home. */\n  stateHome?: string\n  root: string\n  /** Bundled interpreter payload for this CPU; a development tree without one runs without Office skills. */\n  primaryRuntime?: string\n  executable: string\n  addresses(): string[]\n  /** Finish login-shell and system-proxy discovery before a Host child captures `process.env`. */\n  prepareEnvironment?(): Promise<void>\n  /** The system proxy main probed at startup; the main process starts sampling once Electron is ready. */\n  readonly memory: DesktopMemoryMonitor\n  readonly backend: DesktopBackendController<{ start(): Promise<void>; stop(): Promise<void> }>\n  preferences: DesktopPreferences = { ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES }\n  selected: string = DEFAULT_PROFILE\n  safeMode = false\n  recoveryMode = false\n  busy = false\n  closing = false\n  failure = ''\n  failureStage: DesktopFailureStage | undefined\n  failureExit: DesktopHostExit | undefined\n  startup: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()\n  /** Main-process transport only; never copied into a DesktopState. */\n  auth: { url: string; cookie: string; token: string; injections: readonly unknown[] } | undefined\n  lan: DesktopLanHttpsRuntime | undefined\n  private safeHome: string | undefined\n  private hostProcess: DesktopHostProcess | undefined\n  /** Where a backend failure stops the Desktop: preparation, Host startup, or a Host that was running. */\n  private hostStage: DesktopFailureStage = 'host-boot'\n\n  constructor(readonly options: RuntimeOptions) {\n    this.profiles = new NextProfiles(options.home)\n    this.recovery = new NextRecovery(this.profiles)\n    this.settings = new DesktopPreferenceStore(options.stateHome ?? options.home)\n    this.diagnostics = new DesktopDiagnostics(options.home)\n    this.memory = new DesktopMemoryMonitor({ probe: options.memoryProbe,\n      record: input => { this.diagnostics.record(input) }, flush: () => { this.diagnostics.flush() } })\n    this.backend = new DesktopBackendController(onFailure => this.createHost(onFailure), state => {\n      this.diagnostics.record({ source: 'desktop.backend', event: 'phase', fields: { phase: state.phase } })\n      if (state.phase === 'error' && !this.closing) {\n        this.report(state.failure ?? state.message, this.hostStage)\n        // The Host now ships its complete inspected error with `fatal`.  }\n      this.options.onChange()\n    })\n  }\n\n  initialize(): void {\n    try { this.selected = this.profiles.active } catch (error) {\n      if (this.safeMode) this.diagnostics.append(`Original else try { this.preferences = this.settings.read() } catch (error) { this.report(error, 'runtime-bootstrap') }\n    this.diagnostics.level = this.preferences.logLevel\n    this.diagnostics.developer = { dshMarket: true } : {}),\n    ...(features.officialMarket ? { officialMarket: true } : {}),\n  }\n}\n\nexport class NextProfiles {\n  constructor(readonly home: string) {\n    if (!isAbsolute(home)) throw new Error('Next home must be absolute')\n  }\n  directory(name: string): string {\n    const root = join(this.home, 'profiles')\n    const dir = join(root, profileName(name))\n    for (const path of [this.home, root, dir]) {\n      if (existsSync(path) && (!lstatSync(path).isDirectory() || lstatSync(path).isSymbolicLink())) {\n        throw new Error(`Next profile path must be a real directory: ${path}`)\n      }\n    }\n    return dir\n  }\n  get active(): string {\n    const file = join(this.home, 'desktop-next.json')\n    const text = readPrivateFile(file)\n    if (text === undefined) return DEFAULT_PROFILE\n    return profileName((JSON.parse(text) as { active?: unknown }).active)\n  }\n  select(name: string): void {\n    if (!this.selectable(name)) throw new Error('Profile is unavailable for Desktop Next')\n    atomicJson(join(this.home, 'desktop-next.json'), { version: 1, active: name })\n  }\n  /** Read configuration only; never load plugins just to render the native selector. */\n  selectable(name: string): boolean {\n    try {\n      const value = JSON.parse(readPrivateFile(join(this.directory(name), 'package.json')) ?? 'null') as { dsh?: { profile?: { bundles?: unknown } } } | null\n      const bundles = value?.dsh?.profile?.bundles\n      this.features(name)\n      return Array.isArray(bundles) && try { return existsSync(join(this.directory(entry.name), 'package.json')) } catch { return false }\n    }).map(entry => entry.name).sort()\n  }\n  ensure(name: string): string {\n    const dir =   if (manifest.dsh.profile.bundles.includes('dsh-plugin-desktop-beta')) {\n        // Retire the former Next-specific selection from the shared manifest.\n        // Other launchers must not inherit migrated.dsh.profile.bundles = migrated.dsh.profile.bundles.filter(bundle => bundle !== 'dsh-plugin-desktop-beta')\n        atomicJson(join(dir, 'package.json'), migrated)\n      }\n    } else }\n  features(name: string): Features {\n    const manifest = this.manifest(name)\n    if (manifest.dsh.desktopNextPlugins === 1 || !manifest.dsh.profile.bundles.includes('dsh-plugin-desktop-beta')) atomicJson(join(this.directory(name), 'package.json'), manifest)\n  }\n  onboardingRequired(name: string): boolean {\n    const saved = this.manifest(name).dsh.desktopNextOnboarding\n    return Skip preserves both bundles and the user's patch verbatim. */\n  finishOnboarding(name: string, value?: unknown): void {\n    const manifest = this.manifest(name)\n    const patchPath = join(this.directory(name), 'cordis.patch.yml')\n    let originalPatch: string | undefined\n    let nextPatch: string | undefined\n    if (value !== undefined) {\n      if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)\n        || Object.keys(value).some(key => !['features', 'computerUse'].includes(key))) throw new Error('Invalid onboarding choices')\n      const choices = value as Record<string, unknown>\n      const features = parseFeatures(choices.features)\n      if (features.market && features.dshMarket) throw new Error('Select only one plugin market')\n      if (typeof choices.computerUse !== 'boolean') throw new Error('Invalid Computer Use choice')\n      originalPatch = readPrivateFile(patchPath)\n      nextPatch = computerUsePatch(originalPatch ?? 'C:\\\\Windows', 'System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe'),\n        ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-EncodedCommand', Buffer.from(script, 'utf16le').toString('base64')],\n        { signal, timeout: 30_000, windowsHide: true, env: { ...process.env, DSH_UPDATE_INSTALLER: path }, maxBuffer: 16_384 })\n      assertNextWindowsInstaller(JSON.parse(info.stdout.replace(/^\\uFEFF/, '')), version)\n      this.prepared = { path, version }; return\n    }\n    if (this.options.platform !== 'darwin') throw new Error('Unsupported update platform')\n    const mount = join(directory, 'volume'); await mkdir(mount, { mode: 0o700 })\n    const run = (file: string, args: string[]) => execute(file, args, { signal, timeout: 10 * 60_000, maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 })\n    const installed = dirname(dirname(dirname(this.options.executable)))\n    if (!installed.endsWith('.app')) throw new Error('Invalid installed Next application bundle')\n    await run('/usr/bin/codesign', ['--verify', '--deep', '--strict', installed])\n    let attached = false\n    try {\n      await run('/usr/bin/hdiutil', ['attach', '-readonly', '-nobrowse', '-noautoopen', '-mountpoint', mount, path]); attached = true\n      const entries = await readdir(mount, { withFileTypes: true })\n      const apps = entries.filter(entry => entry.isDirectory() && entry.name.endsWith('.app'))\n      if (apps.length !== 1) throw new Error('Expected one application in the Next disk image')\n      const bundle = join(mount, apps[0]!.name)\n      const info = await run('/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy', ['-c', 'Print :CFBundleIdentifier', join(bundle, 'Contents', 'Info.plist')])\n      // Releases through 2.0.17-beta.1 shipped the application unpacked, and every shipped updater reads the manifest\n      // at that location. Archived releases keep a byte-for-byte copy of the archived manifest there as an extra\n      // resource (`build.mac.extraResources`, checked by scripts/packaged-payload.ts) so that they all accept them.\n      const manifestPath = join(bundle, 'Contents', 'Resources', 'app', 'package.json')\n      const meta = await lstat(manifestPath)\n      if (!meta.isFile() || meta.isSymbolicLink() || meta.size > 128 * 1024) throw new Error('Invalid Next application manifest')\n      assertNextMacBundle(info.stdout, JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestPath, 'utf8')), version)\n      await run('/usr/bin/codesign', ['--verify', '--deep', '--strict', bundle])\n      const installedSignature = await run('/usr/bin/codesign', ['-dv', '--verbose=4', installed])\n      const candidateSignature = await run('/usr/bin/codesign', ['-dv', '--verbose=4', bundle])\n      const team = /^TeamIdentifier=([A-Z0-9]+)$/m.exec(installedSignature.stderr)?.[1]\n      if (!team || !candidateSignature.stderr.split('\\n').includes(`TeamIdentifier=${team}`)) throw new Error('Next update signing team does not match the installed application')\n      const staged = join(directory, apps[0]!.name)\n      await run('/usr/bin/ditto', [bundle, staged])\n      this.prepared = { path, version, directory, bundle: staged, installed }\n    } finally {\n      // Do not use the aborted 'win32') return\n    if (this.nativeReady) return\n    if (!prepared.bundle || !prepared.installed || !prepared.directory) throw new Error('No prepared Next update')\n    const stat = await lstat(prepared.bundle)\n    if (!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('Prepared Next application bundle is unavailable')\n    await access(dirname(prepared.installed), constants.W_OK)\n    await access(prepared.installed, constants.W_OK)\n    this.nativeReady = true\n  }\n  /** Called after the Host and windows have finished shutting down. */\n  async launch(): throw new Error('No prepared update installer')\n      const zh = (this.options.language?.() ?? 'en').toLowerCase().startsWith('zh')\n      const message = zh ? `正在更新 DSH Desktop Beta 至 ${prepared.version}，请稍候…` : `Updating DSH Desktop Beta to ${prepared.version}, please wait…`\n      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {\n        const child = spawn('/bin/sh', ['-c', MAC_UPDATE_SCRIPT], {\n          detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', shell: false, cwd: '/',\n          env: {\n            ...process.env,\n            DSH_UPDATE_PID: String(process.pid),\n            DSH_UPDATE_STAGED: prepared.bundle!,\n            DSH_UPDATE_INSTALLED: prepared.installed!,\n            DSH_UPDATE_DIR: prepared.directory!,\n            DSH_UPDATE_TITLE: 'DSH Desktop Beta',\n            DSH_UPDATE_MESSAGE: message,\n            DSH_UPDATE_UI_SCRIPT: MAC_PROGRESS_UI_SCRIPT,\n          },\n        })\n        child.once('error', reject)\n        child.once('spawn', () => { child.off('error', reject); child.on('error', this.options.log); child.unref(); resolve() })\n      })\n      return\n    }\n    if (this.options.platform !== 'win32' || !this.prepared) throw new Error('No prepared update installer')\n    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {\n      const child = spawn(this.prepared!.path, ['--updated', '--force-run'], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', shell: false, windowsHide: false })\n      child.once('error', reject)\n      child.once('spawn', () => { child.off('error', reject); child.on('error', this.options.log); child.unref(); resolve() })\n    })\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/** Main-process update ownership survives a stopped or broken Profile Host. */\nimport { mkdtemp, readdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\nimport { checkForDesktopUpdate, type UpdateCheckResult, type UpdateRequest } from '../../dsh-plugin-desktop/src/update-checker.ts'\nimport { desktopUpdateFilename, downloadDesktopUpdate, type UpdateArtifactRequest } from '../../dsh-plugin-desktop/src/update-download.ts'\nimport { getOrCreateDesktopInstallationId } from '../../dsh-plugin-desktop/src/desktop-installation-id.ts'\nimport { atomicJson, privateDirectory, readPrivateFile } from './private-files.ts'\nimport type { NextUpdateState } from './update-state.ts'\n\nexport interface NextUpdateOptions {\n  version: string\n  platform: string\n  packaged: boolean\n  userData: string\n  /** Fetch adapter for the version check. */\n  request: UpdateRequest\n  /** Installer transport; it owns redirect following and its per-hop HTTPS check. */\n  artifactRequest: UpdateArtifactRequest\n  changed(): void\n  available?(version: string): void\n  log(error: unknown): void\n  prepare(path: string, version: string, directory: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>\n  install(): Promise<void>\n}\n\nexport class NextUpdates {\n  private state: NextUpdateState\n  private result?: UpdateCheckResult\n  private operation?: Promise<void>\n  private controller?: AbortController\n  private timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>\n  private directory?: string\n  private notifiedVersion?: string\n  private cacheReady?: Promise<void>\n  private disposed = false\n  constructor(private readonly options: NextUpdateOptions) {\n    this.state = { phase: 'idle', installable: options.packaged && ['darwin', 'win32'].includes(options.platform) }\n  }\n  snapshot(): NextUpdateState { return { ...this.state } }\n  private initializeCache(): Promise<void> {\n    return this.cacheReady ??= (async () => {\n      const cache = join(this.options.userData, 'next-updates')\n      privateDirectory(cache)\n      try {\n        const text = readPrivateFile(join(cache, 'state.json'), 4096)\n        const parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) as { notifiedVersion?: unknown } : undefined\n        if (typeof parsed?.notifiedVersion === 'string') this.notifiedVersion = parsed.notifiedVersion\n      } catch (error) { this.options.log(error) }\n      // One primary process owns this userData tree. Clean our previous process's\n      // completed installers/partial files; never delete arbitrary files in userData.\n      for (const entry of await readdir(cache, { withFileTypes: true })) {\n        if (entry.isDirectory() && /^download-[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(entry.name)) {\n          await rm(join(cache, entry.name), { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(this.options.log)\n        }\n      }\n    })()\n  }\n  private recordNotifiedVersion(version: string): void {\n    this.notifiedVersion = version\n    try { atomicJson(join(this.options.userData, 'next-updates', 'state.json'), { notifiedVersion: version }) }\n    catch (error) { this.options.log(error) }\n  }\n  private set(patch: Partial<NextUpdateState>): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    this.state = { ...this.state, error: undefined, ...patch }\n    this.options.changed()\n  }\n  start(): void {\n    if (!this.options.packaged || !['darwin', 'win32'].includes(this.options.platform) || this.timer || this.disposed) return\n    void this.initializeCache().catch(this.options.log)\n    const poll = (): void => {\n      if (this.disposed) return\n      if (['idle', 'current', 'error'].includes(this.state.phase)) void this.check(true)\n      this.timer = setTimeout(poll, 6 * 60 * 60_000); this.timer.unref()\n    }\n    this.timer = setTimeout(poll, 30_000); this.timer.unref()\n  }\n  private run(task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.disposed) return Promise.resolve()\n    if (this.operation) return this.operation\n    this.controller = new AbortController()\n    const signal = this.controller.signal\n    this.operation = (async () => {\n      try { await this.initializeCache(); signal.throwIfAborted(); await task(signal) }\n      catch (error) { if (!signal.aborted) { this.options.log(error); this.set({ phase: 'error', error: 'download' }) } }\n    })().finally(() => { this.operation = undefined; this.controller = undefined })\n    return this.operation\n  }\n  private async query(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<UpdateCheckResult | null> {\n    let installationId\n    if (this.options.packaged) {\n      try { installationId = await getOrCreateDesktopInstallationId(this.options.userData) } catch (error) { this.options.log(error) }\n    }\n    return checkForDesktopUpdate({ currentVersion: this.options.version, channel: 'beta', installationId,\n      request: this.options.request, signal: AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(20_000)]) })\n  }\n  check(background = false): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.state.phase === 'ready' || this.state.phase === 'installing') return Promise.resolve()\n    return this.run(async signal => {\n      this.set({ phase: 'checking' })\n      try {\n        this.result = await this.query(signal) ?? undefined\n        if (!this.result) { this.set({ phase: 'error', error: 'service', version: undefined }); return }\n        this.set({ phase: this.result.status === 'update-available' ? 'available' : 'current', version: this.result.latestVersion })\n        if (this.result.status === 'update-available') {\n          if (background && this.state.installable && this.result.latestVersion !== this.notifiedVersion) {\n            this.recordNotifiedVersion(this.result.latestVersion)\n            if (!this.disposed) this.options.available?.(this.result.latestVersion)\n          } else if (!background && this.result.latestVersion !== this.notifiedVersion) {\n            this.recordNotifiedVersion(this.result.latestVersion)\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) { this.options.log(error); this.set({ phase: 'error', error: 'service' }) }\n    })\n  }\n  download(): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.state.installable) {\n      this.set({ phase: 'error', error: this.options.packaged ? 'unsupported' : 'development' }); return Promise.resolve()\n    }\n    if (this.state.phase === 'ready' || this.state.phase === 'installing') return Promise.resolve()\n    return this.run(async signal => {\n      let preparing = false\n      try {\n        // Recheck before a counted download; the service also pins targetVersion across races.\n        this.set({ phase: 'checking' })\n        const result = await this.query(signal)\n        if (!result) { this.set({ phase: 'error', error: 'service' }); return }\n        this.result = result\n        if (result.status !== 'update-available') { this.set({ phase: 'current', version: result.latestVersion }); return }\n        if (result.latestVersion !== this.notifiedVersion) this.recordNotifiedVersion(result.latestVersion)\n        const platform = this.options.platform as 'darwin' | 'win32'\n        const cache = join(this.options.userData, 'next-updates'); privateDirectory(cache)\n        if (this.directory) await rm(this.directory, { recursive: true, force: true })\n        const directory = this.directory = await mkdtemp(join(cache, 'download-'))\n        this.set({ phase: 'downloading', version: result.latestVersion, received: 0, total: undefined })\n        let lastProgress = 0\n        const path = await downloadDesktopUpdate({ platform, version: result.latestVersion, channel: 'beta',\n          destinationPath: join(directory, desktopUpdateFilename(platform, result.latestVersion, 'beta')),\n          request: this.options.artifactRequest, expectedSha256: result.installerSha256?.[platform],\n          signal: AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(60 * 60_000)]), onProgress: (received, total) => {\n            if (Date.now() - lastProgress < 250 && received !== total) return\n            lastProgress = Date.now(); this.set({ received, total })\n          } })\n        signal.throwIfAborted()\n        preparing = true; this.set({ phase: 'preparing' })\n        await this.options.prepare(path, result.latestVersion, directory, signal)\n        signal.throwIfAborted()\n        this.set({ phase: 'ready' })\n      } catch (error) {\n        this.options.log(error)\n        this.set({ phase: 'error', error: preparing ? 'prepare' : 'download' })\n      }\n    })\n  }\n  async install(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.disposed || this.state.phase !== 'ready') return\n    this.set({ phase: 'installing' })\n    try { await this.options.install() }\n    catch (error) { this.options.log(error); this.set({ phase: 'error', error: 'install' }) }\n  }\n  async dispose(keepInstaller = false): Promise<void> {\n    this.disposed = true\n    clearTimeout(this.timer)\n    this.controller?.abort()\n    await this.operation\n    if (this.directory && !keepInstaller) await rm(this.directory, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(this.options.log)\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/** Local Web document and authenticated HTTP forwarding for the application window. */\nimport { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'\nimport { extname, resolve, sep } from 'node:path'\nimport type { OnBeforeSendHeadersListenerDetails, WebContents } from 'electron'\nimport { NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER } from './desktop-contract.ts'\n\nconst MIME: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {\n  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',\n  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.json': 'application/json',\n  '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.png': 'image/png', '.ico': 'image/x-icon',\n}\n/**\n * Pre-Cordis globals injected into the application index.\n *\n * `__DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__` is the file-upload plugin's documented page-owned carrier. Without it the\n * plugin posts Blob and stream bodies from a blob-URL dedicated Worker, and Electron never shows\n * Worker requests on a custom protocol to `webRequest` (verified on Electron 44.0.0): they cannot\n * carry the native renderer marker, and the protocol handler cannot tell an owned Worker from one\n * started by another window or a foreign frame. Every non-image attachment therefore received the\n * gate's 403. The page's own `fetch` runs in the owned main frame, which the gate already marks.\n * The carrier reports no byte progress; uploads go to the loopback Host, so the card only skips\n * its intermediate progress.\n */\nexport const APP_BOOT_SCRIPT = '<script>globalThis.__DSH_BOOT_READY__ = Promise.withResolvers();'\n  + 'globalThis.__DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__ = { fetch: (input, init) => fetch(input, init) }</script>'\n// Cover both the empty document and the official boot page; normal UI keeps its own palette.\nconst LOADING_STYLE = `<style id=\"dsh-next-loading-style\">\nhtml:has(#root:empty), html:has([data-dsh-boot]) { color-scheme: dark; background: #000 !important; }\nbody:has(#root:empty), body:has([data-dsh-boot]) { background: #000 !important; }\n[data-dsh-boot] {\n  background: #000 !important;\n  --dsw-alias-bg-base: #000;\n  --dsw-alias-label-primary: #f9fafb;\n  --dsw-alias-label-secondary: #cfd3d6;\n  --dsw-alias-label-tertiary: #adb2b8;\n  --dsw-alias-border-l2: rgb(255 255 255 / 12%);\n  --dsw-alias-brand-primary: #f9fafb;\n}\n</style>`\n\n/** Mark live same-origin frames in the owned window; strip the marker from other targets and redirects. */\nexport function appRequestHeaders(\n  request: Pick<OnBeforeSendHeadersListenerDetails, 'url' | 'webContentsId' | 'webContents' | 'frame' | 'resourceType' | 'requestHeaders'>,\n  owner: Pick<WebContents, 'id' | 'mainFrame'> | undefined,\n  nativeToken: string | undefined,\n): Record<string, string> {\n  const headers = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(request.requestHeaders)\n    .filter(([name]) => name.toLowerCase() !== NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER))\n  const target = new URL(request.url)\n  if (target.protocol === 'dsh-app:' && target.host === 'app' && !target.username && !target.password && owner && nativeToken\n    && request.webContentsId === owner.id && (!request.webContents || request.webContents.id === owner.id)\n    && request.resourceType !== 'mainFrame' && request.frame\n    && !request.frame.detached && request.frame.origin === 'dsh-app://app') headers[NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER] = nativeToken\n  return headers\n}\n\n/**\n * Read an application-owned static asset; the index waits for asynchronous Host injections.\n * @param request - Local application request.\n * @param root - Packaged Web dist directory.\n * @returns Static response, or a missing/invalid path response.\n */\nexport async function serveWebDocument(request: Request, root: string, waitForHost = true): Promise<Response> {\n  if (!['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(request.method)) return new Response(null, { status: 405 })\n  const url = new URL(request.url)\n  let pathname: string\n  try { pathname = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname) } catch { return new Response(null, { status: 400 }) }\n  const target = resolve(root, '.' + (pathname === '/' ? '/index.html' : pathname))\n  const directory = resolve(root)\n  if (!target.startsWith(directory + sep)) return new Response(null, { status: 403 })\n  let body: Buffer\n  try { body = await readFile(target) } catch (error) {\n    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return new Response(null, { status: 404 })\n    throw error\n  }\n  const content = waitForHost && (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html')\n    ? body.toString().replace('<head>', '<head>' + LOADING_STYLE + APP_BOOT_SCRIPT) : new Uint8Array(body)\n  return new Response(request.method === 'HEAD' ? null : content, {\n    headers: { 'content-type': MIME[extname(target)] ?? 'application/octet-stream' },\n  })\n}\n\n/**\n * Exchange the Host launch URL for an authority-bound browser cookie.\n * @param url - Authenticated URL reported by the owned Host process.\n * @returns Cookie header for requests forwarded to that Host.\n */\nexport async function authenticateWebHost(url: string, nativeToken?: string): Promise<string> {\n  const response = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'manual', ...(nativeToken ? { headers: { [NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER]: nativeToken } } : {}) })\n  const cookie = response.headers.get('set-cookie')\n  await response.body?.cancel()\n  if (response.status !== 303 || cookie === null) throw new Error('Desktop Host authentication failed')\n  const end = cookie.indexOf(';')\n  return end < 0 ? cookie : cookie.slice(0, end)\n}\n\n/**\n * Response headers not relayed to the renderer. `set-cookie` would hand the\n * Host's authentication cookie to the page's cookie jar, which the shell owns\n * instead; the rest describe the Node `fetch` connection (its encoding, length,\n * and hop-by-hop transport), which Chromium never sees.\n */\nconst WITHHELD_RESPONSE_HEADERS = [\n  'set-cookie',\n  'content-encoding', 'content-length',\n  'transfer-encoding', 'connection', 'keep-alive', 'te', 'trailer', 'upgrade', 'proxy-authenticate', 'proxy-authorization',\n]\n\n/** Host routes whose responses carry immutable cache headers keyed by a per-process revision. */\nconst PLUGIN_BUNDLE_PATH = /^\\/plugins\\//u\n\n/**\n * Forward local application requests to its authenticated Host, preserving streaming and cancellation.\n * Plugin bundle responses lose their `cache-control` for `no-store`: the Host marks them immutable\n * under a revision that changes every launch, so Chromium's disk cache would only accumulate bundles\n * no later launch can reuse.\n * @param request - Request from the application origin.\n * @param host - Owned Host URL.\n * @param cookie - Host-issued authentication cookie.\n * @returns Host response without connection-level headers.\n */\nexport async function forwardWebRequest(request: Request, host: string, cookie: string, nativeToken: string): Promise<Response> {\n  const source = new URL(request.url)\n  const origin = request.headers.get('origin')\n  // Custom-protocol fetches can omit Origin. The native session marks only\n  // requests from live same-origin frames in our owned window; an HTTP header or referrer alone is\n  // insufficient. Keep this compatible with the upstream's Electron 44.0 ABI.\n  if (source.protocol !== 'dsh-app:' || source.host !== 'app' || source.username || source.password\n    || !nativeToken || request.headers.get(NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER) !== nativeToken) return new Response(null, { status: 403 })\n  if (origin !== null && origin !== 'dsh-app://app') return new Response(null, { status: 403 })\n  // The official connect.js accepts an explicit ws query. Its same-origin\n  // fallback would otherwise derive ws://app from this custom-protocol iframe.\n  // Keep the frontend local, and use the authenticated Host's public CDP proxy\n  // (not the Inspector Worker's private port). Its CSP already permits loopback.\n  if (source.pathname === '/inspector/devtools/devtools_app.html' && ['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(request.method)) {\n    const endpoint = new URL(host)\n    if (endpoint.protocol !== 'http:' || endpoint.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' || endpoint.username || endpoint.password) {\n      return new Response(null, { status: 503 })\n    }\n    endpoint.pathname = '/inspector/devtools/cdp'\n    endpoint.search = ''\n    endpoint.hash = ''\n    for (const id of source.searchParams.getAll('clientSourceId')) endpoint.searchParams.append('clientSourceId', id)\n    const connection = endpoint.host + endpoint.pathname + endpoint.search\n    if (source.searchParams.getAll('ws').length !== 1 || source.searchParams.get('ws') !== connection || source.searchParams.has('wss')) {\n      source.searchParams.delete('wss')\n      source.searchParams.set('ws', connection)\n      return new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: { location: source.href, 'cache-control': 'no-store' } })\n    }\n  }\n  const target = new URL(host)\n  target.pathname = source.pathname\n  target.search = source.search\n  const headers = new Headers(request.headers)\n  for (const name of ['host', 'origin', 'cookie', 'sec-fetch-site', NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER]) headers.delete(name)\n  headers.set('cookie', cookie)\n  headers.set(NATIVE_ACCESS_HEADER, nativeToken)\n  // Preserve same-origin semantics for every owned plugin route, including\n  // /dsh-market/*. Translate only after validating the native frame marker and\n  // source origin; the HTTP client supplies Host from this owned target URL.\n  headers.set('origin', target.origin)\n  headers.set('sec-fetch-site', 'same-origin')\n  const init = { method: request.method, headers, body: request.body, signal: request.signal, duplex: 'half', redirect: 'manual' as const }\n  const response = await fetch(target, init)\n  const outgoing = new Headers(response.headers)\n  for (const name of WITHHELD_RESPONSE_HEADERS) outgoing.delete(name)\n  if (PLUGIN_BUNDLE_PATH.test(source.pathname)) outgoing.set('cache-control', 'no-store')\n  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers: outgoing })\n}\n"

      "content": "/** Keep upstream HTTP routing while requiring Host credentials for Market routes. */\nimport { hostLog, hostOperation } from './host/logging.ts'\nimport WebServer, { type WebRoute, type WebUpgradeRoute } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection'\nimport { decideDesktopBrowserAccess, nextBrowserAccess } from './desktop-browser-access.ts'\nimport { wrapFallback, wrapRegistration, type ResponderWrappers, type WebFallback, type WebRegistration } from './upstream-family.ts'\nimport type { Duplex } from 'node:stream'\n\nconst MARKET_ROUTE = '/api/community-market'\nconst isMarketRoute = (path: string): boolean => path === MARKET_ROUTE || path.startsWith(`${MARKET_ROUTE}/`)\n\nexport default class NextWebServer extends WebServer {\n  static override Config = WebServer.Config\n  private readonly browserSockets = new Set<Duplex>()\n\n  /** Revoke existing browser streams as well as new requests; native streams stay alive. */\n  setBrowserAccess(enabled: boolean): void {\n    const access = nextBrowserAccess()\n    if (!access) throw new Error('Native browser-access policy is unavailable')\n    access.setOrdinaryBrowserEnabled(enabled)\n    if (!enabled) {\n      for (const socket of this.browserSockets) socket.destroy()\n      this.browserSockets.clear()\n    }\n  }\n\n  private permits(request: Parameters<WebRoute['handler']>[0]): boolean {\n    const access = nextBrowserAccess()\n    return !access || decideDesktopBrowserAccess(access, request) !== 'denied'\n  }\n\n  /** The same decision for a Fetch request, which carries the client's headers but no socket. */\n  private permitsFetch(request: Request): boolean {\n    const access = nextBrowserAccess()\n    return !access || decideDesktopBrowserAccess(access, { headers: Object.fromEntries(request.headers), url: request.url }) !== 'denied'\n  }\n\n  override register(route: WebRegistration): () => void {\n    return super.register(wrapRegistration(route, this.policy(route.path)))\n  }\n\n  override registerFallback(fallback: WebFallback): () => void {\n    return super.registerFallback(wrapFallback(fallback, this.policy('fallback')))\n  }\n\n  private policy(route: string): ResponderWrappers {\n    return {\n      handler: inner => this.observeHttp(route, async (request, response) => {\n        if (!this.permits(request)) { response.writeHead(403, { 'cache-control': 'no-store' }); response.end('Browser access is disabled'); return }\n        if (!isMarketRoute(route)) {\n          await inner(request, response); return\n        }\n        const connection = this.ctx.get('connection')\n        const rejection = connection === undefined ? 503 : connection.requestRejection(request)\n        if (rejection !== undefined) {\n          response.writeHead(rejection, { 'cache-control': 'no-store' })\n          response.end('Market request authentication required')\n          return\n        }\n        await inner(request, response)\n      }),\n      resource: (inner) => {\n        // Market credentials are checked on the request socket, which only a handler sees.\n        if (isMarketRoute(route)) throw new Error(`Market route ${route} must be a handler`)\n        return async (request, peer) => {\n          const end = hostOperation('host.http', 'request', { route, method: request.method }, true)\n          try {\n            // An HTTP request arrives without a Peer; an in-process read was admitted by its caller.\n            if (peer === undefined && !this.permitsFetch(request)) {\n              end(undefined, { status: 403 })\n              return new Response('Browser access is disabled', { status: 403, headers: { 'cache-control': 'no-store' } })\n            }\n            const response = await inner(request, peer)\n            end(undefined, { status: response.status })\n            return response\n          } catch (error) { end(error); throw error }\n        }\n      },\n    }\n  }\n\n  private observeHttp(route: string, handler: WebRoute['handler']): WebRoute['handler'] {\n    return async (request, response) => {\n      const end = hostOperation('host.http', 'request', { route, method: request.method ?? '' }, true)\n      const finish = () => { end(undefined, { status: response.statusCode, aborted: !response.writableFinished }); response.off('finish', finish); response.off('close', finish) }\n      response.once('finish', finish); response.once('close', finish)\n      try { await handler(request, response) } catch (error) { response.off('finish', finish); response.off('close', finish); end(error); throw error }\n    }\n  }\n\n  override registerUpgrade(route: WebUpgradeRoute): () => void {\n    return super.registerUpgrade({ ...route, handler: (request, socket, head) => {\n      hostLog({ source: 'host.http', event: 'upgrade', fields: { route: route.path }, developer: true })\n      if (!this.permits(request)) { socket.end('HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\nContent-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n'); return }\n      const access = nextBrowserAccess()\n      if (access && decideDesktopBrowserAccess(access, request) === 'browser') {\n        this.browserSockets.add(socket)\n        socket.once('close', () => this.browserSockets.delete(socket))\n      }\n      return route.handler(request, socket, head)\n    } })\n  }\n}\n"
